summary: In the untended temple branch, C runs the ghost creation path after its rn2(5) success. The JavaScript room caller passes only rn2 through priest.js:intemple, which forwards that partial RNG object to makemon; creationEnv rejects it because makemon requires d, rn1, rn2, rnd, and rne. The source path also uses makemon_runtime for this ordinary-play MM_NOMSG creation so the asynchronous runtime tail completes before intemple consumes the returned monster. Repair intemple’s creation adapter while preserving supplied RNG overrides and defaulting the remaining source RNG operations to the game stream.
